package config

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/kelseyhightower/envconfig"
)

// Config contains environment configuration for the teacher-agent service.
type Config struct {
	HTTPBindAddress  string `envconfig:"HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS" default:"0.0.0.0"`
	HTTPPort         string `envconfig:"HTTP_PORT" default:"8080"`
	DatabaseURL      string `envconfig:"DATABASE_URL" default:"postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/ms_teacher_agent?sslmode=disable"`
	NATSURL          string `envconfig:"NATS_URL" default:"nats://localhost:4222"`
	InternalAPIToken string `envconfig:"INTERNAL_API_TOKEN"`
	ShutdownTimeout  int    `envconfig:"SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT" default:"10"`

	OutboxPollIntervalMS        int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS" default:"500"`
	OutboxBatchSize             int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE" default:"50"`
	OutboxLockTTLSeconds        int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS" default:"300"`
	OutboxRetryBaseSeconds      int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS" default:"1"`
	OutboxRetryMaxSeconds       int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS" default:"300"`
	OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds int `envconfig:"OUTBOX_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" default:"5"`
	NATSConnectTimeoutSeconds   int `envconfig:"NATS_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" default:"2"`

	StudentServiceBaseURL         string `envconfig:"STUDENT_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8081"`
	StudentServiceInternalToken   string `envconfig:"STUDENT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	StudentServiceTeacherToken    string `envconfig:"STUDENT_SERVICE_TEACHER_TOKEN" default:"change-me-teacher"`
	CourseServiceBaseURL          string `envconfig:"COURSE_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8082"`
	CourseServiceInternalToken    string `envconfig:"COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	DialogServiceBaseURL          string `envconfig:"DIALOG_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8095"`
	DialogServiceInternalToken    string `envconfig:"DIALOG_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	DialogSpaceKey                string `envconfig:"DIALOG_SPACE_KEY" default:"platform"`
	AIPromptServiceBaseURL        string `envconfig:"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8091"`
	AIPromptServiceInternalToken  string `envconfig:"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	StatisticServiceBaseURL       string `envconfig:"STATISTIC_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8083"`
	StatisticServiceInternalToken string `envconfig:"STATISTIC_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	LearningPlannerBaseURL        string `envconfig:"LEARNING_PLANNER_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8096"`
	LearningPlannerInternalToken  string `envconfig:"LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	PracticeServiceBaseURL        string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8080"`
	PracticeServiceInternalToken  string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	// Optional while S8 is dark on a pre-021/S7 deployment.  A non-empty value
	// is always a dedicated credential; enabling S8 requires one.
	LearningPlannerTeacherToken       string `envconfig:"LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN"`
	DependencyTimeoutSeconds          int    `envconfig:"DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" default:"3"`
	OnboardingActionLeaseSeconds      int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_ACTION_LEASE_SECONDS" default:"30"`
	OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_ONBOARDING_CANONICAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled         bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_UNIFIED_COORDINATOR_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled     bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_PRODUCT_AWARE_ONBOARDING_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled   bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled      bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	NextBestActionEnabled             bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_NEXT_BEST_ACTION_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	OnboardingHandoffPollIntervalMS   int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS" default:"250"`
	OnboardingHandoffLeaseSeconds     int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS" default:"30"`
	OnboardingHandoffRetryBaseSeconds int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS" default:"1"`
	OnboardingHandoffRetryMaxSeconds  int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS" default:"300"`
	OnboardingHandoffMaxAttempts      int    `envconfig:"ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_MAX_ATTEMPTS" default:"20"`
	AIPromptTimeoutSeconds            int    `envconfig:"AI_PROMPT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" default:"70"`

	TeacherDialogWorkerPollIntervalMS int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS" default:"250"`
	TeacherDialogWorkerBatchSize      int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_BATCH_SIZE" default:"10"`
	TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds   int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS" default:"180"`
	TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency    int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_CONCURRENCY" default:"2"`
	TeacherDialogLeaseRenewSeconds    int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_LEASE_RENEW_SECONDS" default:"30"`
	TeacherDialogMaxAttempts          int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_MAX_ATTEMPTS" default:"20"`
	TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled bool `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_DENSE_ORDERING_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	TeacherDialogRetryBaseSeconds     int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS" default:"1"`
	TeacherDialogRetryMaxSeconds      int  `envconfig:"TEACHER_DIALOG_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS" default:"300"`

	TelegramBotToken             string `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"`
	TelegramBotUsername          string `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME"`
	TelegramWebhookSecret        string `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET"`
	TelegramAPIBaseURL           string `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL" default:"https://api.telegram.org"`
	TelegramWorkerPollIntervalMS int    `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS" default:"500"`
	TelegramWorkerLeaseSeconds   int    `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS" default:"30"`
	TelegramRetryBaseSeconds     int    `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS" default:"1"`
	TelegramRetryMaxSeconds      int    `envconfig:"TELEGRAM_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS" default:"300"`
}

// Validate rejects runtime values that would violate relay lease guarantees.
func (cfg Config) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.HTTPBindAddress) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.HTTPPort) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DatabaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.NATSURL) == "" {
		return errors.New("HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS, HTTP_PORT, DATABASE_URL, and NATS_URL are required")
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled && !cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_CANONICAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED requires TEACHER_UNIFIED_COORDINATOR_ENABLED")
	}
	if cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled && (!cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled || !cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled) {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_UNIFIED_COORDINATOR_ENABLED requires canonical onboarding actions and dense dialog ordering")
	}
	if cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled && (!cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled || !cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled || !cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled) {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_PRODUCT_AWARE_ONBOARDING_ENABLED requires dense dialog ordering, canonical onboarding actions, and unified coordinator")
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled && (!cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled || !cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled || !cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled || !cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled) {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED requires product-aware onboarding, dense dialog ordering, canonical onboarding actions, and unified coordinator")
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled && !cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME_ENABLED requires TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StudentServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StudentServiceInternalToken) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StudentServiceTeacherToken) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.CourseServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DialogServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DialogServiceInternalToken) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.DialogSpaceKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.AIPromptServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.AIPromptServiceInternalToken) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StatisticServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StatisticServiceInternalToken) == "" {
		return errors.New("student, course, dialog, AI Prompt, Statistic, and Learning Planner service URLs and tokens are required")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StudentServiceTeacherToken) == strings.TrimSpace(cfg.StudentServiceInternalToken) {
		return errors.New("STUDENT_SERVICE_TEACHER_TOKEN must differ from STUDENT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LearningPlannerBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken) == "" {
		return errors.New("learning planner service URL and token are required")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.PracticeServiceBaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.PracticeServiceInternalToken) == "" {
		return errors.New("practice service URL and token are required")
	}
	handoffToken := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken)
	if cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled && handoffToken == "" {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED requires LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN")
	}
	if handoffToken != "" && handoffToken == strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken) {
		return errors.New("LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN must differ from LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	}
	if cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds <= 0 || cfg.OnboardingActionLeaseSeconds <= 2*cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds || cfg.AIPromptTimeoutSeconds <= 0 ||
		cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerPollIntervalMS <= 0 || cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerBatchSize <= 0 ||
		cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds <= 0 || cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency <= 0 || cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency > 16 ||
		cfg.TeacherDialogLeaseRenewSeconds <= 0 || cfg.TeacherDialogLeaseRenewSeconds*2 >= cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds ||
		cfg.TeacherDialogMaxAttempts < 1 || cfg.TeacherDialogRetryBaseSeconds <= 0 ||
		cfg.TeacherDialogRetryMaxSeconds < cfg.TeacherDialogRetryBaseSeconds {
		return errors.New("teacher dialog and onboarding action durations and batch size must be positive and cover dependencies")
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingHandoffPollIntervalMS <= 0 || cfg.OnboardingHandoffLeaseSeconds <= cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds ||
		cfg.OnboardingHandoffRetryBaseSeconds <= 0 || cfg.OnboardingHandoffRetryMaxSeconds < cfg.OnboardingHandoffRetryBaseSeconds ||
		cfg.OnboardingHandoffMaxAttempts < 1 {
		return errors.New("onboarding handoff worker durations and attempts must be positive and cover the Planner dependency")
	}
	// One attempt can make a best-effort confidential summary call followed by
	// the required response call, plus bounded owner-context reads.
	minimumDialogLease := 2*cfg.AIPromptTimeoutSeconds + 4*cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds
	if cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds <= minimumDialogLease {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS must cover AI Prompt and dependency timeouts")
	}
	if cfg.ShutdownTimeout <= 0 || cfg.OutboxPollIntervalMS <= 0 || cfg.OutboxBatchSize <= 0 ||
		cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds <= 0 || cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds <= 0 ||
		cfg.OutboxRetryMaxSeconds < cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds || cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds <= 0 ||
		cfg.NATSConnectTimeoutSeconds <= 0 {
		return errors.New("runtime durations and outbox batch size must be positive")
	}
	telegramValues := []string{cfg.TelegramBotToken, cfg.TelegramBotUsername, cfg.TelegramWebhookSecret}
	configured := false
	for _, value := range telegramValues {
		configured = configured || strings.TrimSpace(value) != ""
	}
	if configured && (!cfg.TelegramEnabled() || strings.TrimSpace(cfg.TelegramAPIBaseURL) == "") {
		return errors.New("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME, TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL must be configured together")
	}
	if configured && (cfg.TelegramWorkerPollIntervalMS <= 0 || cfg.TelegramWorkerLeaseSeconds <= 0 ||
		cfg.TelegramRetryBaseSeconds <= 0 || cfg.TelegramRetryMaxSeconds < cfg.TelegramRetryBaseSeconds) {
		return errors.New("telegram worker durations must be positive")
	}
	minimumLeaseSeconds := int64(cfg.OutboxBatchSize) * int64(cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds)
	if int64(cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds) <= minimumLeaseSeconds {
		return errors.New("OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS must cover the sequential batch publish timeout")
	}
	return nil
}

func (cfg Config) TelegramEnabled() bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(cfg.TelegramBotToken) != "" && strings.TrimSpace(cfg.TelegramBotUsername) != "" &&
		strings.TrimSpace(cfg.TelegramWebhookSecret) != ""
}

// Load reads Config from environment variables.
func Load() (Config, error) {
	var cfg Config
	err := envconfig.Process("", &cfg)
	return cfg, err
}
